scope: Initial dbt flow: reviewed full-build candidates, local dbt/DuckDB execution, model documentation and independent synthetic reconciliation
engineering_recommendation: Ready for supervised Snowflake development validation

gates.required: Approved development connection/profile, role, warehouse and dedicated database/schema; scoped catalogue, full native build, independent reconciliation and operating evidence
Human acceptance of the exact candidate version, definitions, documentation, deployment diff, operating ownership and rollback procedure
Native source/Omni results, security identities and consumer behavior for the selected migration

limits: Synthetic metadata does not establish live warehouse catalogue completeness or permissions.
One internally authored retail trial does not establish generalization across customer repositories or repeated fresh-agent reliability.
Incremental models, production scheduling, workload scale/cost and native recovery remain unqualified.
Passing artifact verification is not authenticated execution or human authorization.
